worldcombat.skill.ficklebeam.summary: A thin, cost-free Dragon beam: it hits the nearest enemy in the corridor, and each shot has a chance that all the light strands fire in unison for double power.
worldcombat.skill.ficklebeam.description: The beam deals %1$s Dragon special damage, reaches %2$s blocks and is %3$s blocks half-wide, striking only the nearest first target.
Each shot has a %1$s chance that all the heads (%2$s strands) fire in unison, doubling this shot's power.
worldcombat.skill.ficklebeam.unison.on: Unison: +0.12 unison chance at the cost of power ×0.88 and +2 wind-up - gamble on the doubled shot.
worldcombat.skill.ficklebeam.unison.off: Casual: power ×1.12 and the chance follows the individual's own data - a steady hit.
worldcombat.skill.ficklebeam.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s, %5$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.ficklebeam.growth.0: From level %1$s the beam power steps up to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.ficklebeam.growth.1: From level %1$s the beam power reaches %2$s and the unison chance rises to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.ficklebeam.use.0: A thin, cost-free ranged Dragon beam
worldcombat.skill.ficklebeam.use.1: Gamble on all strands firing in unison for double power
worldcombat.skill.ficklebeam.use.2: Wear a foe down from a distance
On: +0.12 unison chance at the cost of power ×0.88 and +2 wind-up - gamble on the doubled shot. Off (casual): power ×1.12 and the chance follows the individual's own data for a steady hit.
Above this distance the companion closes in before firing. This move costs nothing, so a larger value lets it start wearing foes down sooner.
